sourceChecks.note: The factory's exact 2416/420059 page validates the current homogeneous steel-bracelet reference, 39.6 x 46 x 15 mm dimensions, 128 g full weight, 18 mm bracelet width, steel case and bracelet, calibre 2416B, -20/+60 seconds per day, at least 31 hours of reserve, 200 m water resistance, organic crystal, date, and luminous paint on the hands and hour markers. It does not identify the bracelet-to-case mechanism.

The exact retailer page supplies the current $164 sale price and add-to-cart status and independently corroborates reference identity, configuration, 15 x 46 mm thickness/length, 18 mm bracelet width, movement, rate, reserve, screw-down crown, 200 m water resistance, organic crystal, and date. Its rounded 39 mm diameter is superseded by the factory's 39.6 mm dimension.

Meranom explicitly identifies itself as a Chistopol retailer close to—not part of—the factory, states that factory warranty is supported, and says that it sells new watches. Its product facts remain reviewed secondary evidence rather than manufacturer-primary evidence.

The exact-reference specialist listing reports an approximately 128 g full weight for the steel-bracelet configuration and independently corroborates the geometry, movement, rate, reserve, crystal, water resistance, and luminous-paint presence.
A separate exact-reference Vostok dealer also reports 128 g for the stainless-steel bracelet configuration, corroborating the full-weight value.

A verified-purchase exact-reference owner calls the lume underwhelming. This qualitative report is insufficient alone, but it corroborates two independent exact-reference reviews and a separate long-term owner's assessment of poor nighttime performance.

The exact-reference review identifies sparse lume on the hands and small dot indices and explicitly warns that reference 420059 can be difficult to read in poor lighting. This supports the catalogue's weak performance class when combined with the independent fade and owner reports.

This second exact-reference review identifies model 420059 and reports that its luminous compound fades quickly. The review's speculative explanation of the design intent is not adopted; only the observed performance direction is used.

A separate exact-reference long-term daily owner describes the factory lume as poor. This is retained only as corroboration for the two editorial exact-reference assessments and the verified-purchase report.

The specialist's replacement 420 case includes spring bars for the band connection, but it is a dealer-supplied component rather than manufacturer service evidence for the factory bracelet on exact reference 420059. It does not meet the catalogue's physical-interface corroboration policy.

note: Keep as research-only. Vostok's exact factory page now provides primary evidence for the homogeneous 2416/420059 steel-bracelet configuration, including 39.6 x 46 x 15 mm dimensions and 128 g full weight. Multiple independent exact-reference reviews and owners converge on sparse, fast-fading, poor nighttime performance, resolving lumeGrade as weak without relying on luminous-material presence alone. The bracelet interface remains open: the factory page names only the bracelet material and width, the available pins discussion is ambiguous between removable links and case attachment, and dealer-supplied 420-case spring-bar evidence still lacks manufacturer service corroboration for the factory bracelet.
